content.short: Snowball is an intuitive savings app that harnesses DeFi to offer users competitive interest rates.
content.description: Snowball, founded in 2018 by Parul Gujral, aims to disrupt traditional banking by enabling savings through high-yield stablecoin vaults within decentralized finance. It offers a competitive interest rate on savings, with interest shown in real time and automatic compounding of returns. By continuously compounding accrued gains, Snowball delivers compounded growth on user savings over time, leveraging transparent DeFi mechanisms to manage deposits.
